# Ahmed Perfumes (Ahmed Al Maghribi Perfumes)

> A leading Emirati brand specializing in luxury oriental fragrances. Founded by
> Kafeel Ahmed in the UAE in 2000, the brand offers over 100 perfumes blending oud
> and authentic Arabian incense with modern Western fragrance notes.
